name: meta-edit
description: Single-plugin marketplace exposing the meta-edit Claude Code plugin: twenty-one kind-specific edit_* MCP tools and two safety hooks.

plugins.name: meta-edit
plugins.description: Replaces raw Edit / Write / MultiEdit with twenty-one kind-specific edit_* MCP tools (15 SQLite-derived + edit_cosmetic + 5 workflow-axis kinds) that encode the testing obligations for each kind of change directly in their tool descriptions. Every declaration carries a required provenance field. Impl tools carry a required prod/test target flag.
